tasks.task_text: Show me the shared rooms in any university in Melbourne that has a private bathroom wifi, and gas included in the bills.

steps: On the homepage click the Melbourne button or use the search box to search for Melbourne
Click 'View all properties in Melbourne' to go to the full list page
Click 'All Filters' button to open the filters dialog
In the Room Type section check the 'Shared Room' option
In the Bathroom section check the 'Private' option
In the Bills Include section check the 'Wifi' option
In the Bills Include section check the 'Gas' option
Click 'Apply Filters' button to apply the filter criteria
key_points: Must simultaneously satisfy 4 filter criteria: shared room type + private bathroom + wifi bills included + gas bills included
Bills Include Wifi and Facilities & Security Wifi are different options, must select Bills Include
Filters will display real-time matching number of results (22→2→2→2)
Final URL will contain all filter parameters: category[]=shared-room&bathroom_type[]=private&facility[]=gas_any&facility[]=wifi_any
Some properties may show Sold Out status, need to pay attention
Can select any properties near any university matching the criteria, task does not specify a specific university
common_mistakes: Did not check all 4 required filter criteria, causing inaccurate results
Confused Bills Include and Facilities Wifi options
Did not wait for filter results to fully load before extracting information
Ignored properties with Sold Out status
Did not click Apply Filters and assumed the filter was applied
